newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUG 11.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUG 11.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* Ringgit recovers slightly on Monday morning after dropping 1.9 percent on Friday after Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said Malaysia was comfortable with the currency.
* On Friday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell by 156.78 points or 1.91 percent to 8,031.22, buckling under mounting pressure of rapidly rising interest rates
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index staged mild recovery, ending up 4.03 points at 032.36, ahead of the weekend on buying by local funds responding to a call by the prime minister.
* "Logically the market should dip. It will be a battle between the usual foreign sellers and local funds trying to prop up the market," said a dealer with a foreign brokerage.
* Most analysts said share prices would be dragged down by the falling ringgit and weak corporate results
* Focus would be on debut of General Soil Engineering, after the last listing, Utama Banking, failed to make an impression.
